planned_outcome: Land HMS Resolute M20: take M9 Stefan exactly as-is and free alpha_dough over (5e-7, 1e-5) and delta_T_smear over (3, 10 C). Single-fixture diagnostic on BA3C_0946 first. If main-bake RMSE drops below 4 C, sweep all 5 unlidded fixtures + LOO test. This is the focused targeted fix following M19's RCA finding that alpha_dough was pinned 5-7x too low across all prior Stefan/Luikov missions.
actual_outcome: RCA-prescribed targeted fix tested empirically. M9 Stefan extended to free alpha_dough (5e-7..1e-5 m2/s SI) and delta_T_smear (3..10 C). Single-fixture BA3C_0946: main-bake RMSE 5.73 C vs M9 5.76 C — improvement 0.03 C, statistically zero. Both new free params landed INTERIOR (alpha_dough=3.21e-4 norm, smear=5.02 C) — the optimizer found the right values but the residual is unchanged. RCA hypothesis empirically REFUTED. The 5-6 C floor is structural across 18 missions and is set by the deep-end information limit (M13 LOO), not by mis-pinned parameters. Verdict CONFIRM-information-limit (final). Pivot to M18 Method 1 + Method 4 stub for production.
success_metric_result: BA3C_0946 main-bake RMSE 5.73 C (M9: 5.76); both new params interior; no improvement. 18 inverse-problem missions converge on same floor across 5 model classes.

adopt: RCA hypotheses must be empirically tested before claimed as fix; bound-hitting alone doesn't prove the bound was the binding constraint
avoid: Treating any RCA prediction as final without an empirical confirmation run on a single fixture before sweep
